_comment: Per-PR demo for #1349: is_sidestep is one of the two classifiers this PR converts to square-space distance guards, so the clip drives a real side-step through SelectionManager rather than a scenario that never touches those functions.
caption: Side-step classification in square space: a lone Spearmen regiment is ordered a ~28 wu step to its right -- under SIDESTEP_MAX_DISTANCE (40) -- so UnitManeuver.is_sidestep classifies it as a side-step and the regiment shuffles right at a walk while holding its south-facing line, instead of pivoting to face the move and back. is_sidestep and is_lateral_pivot now compare move_vec.length_squared() against a squared threshold instead of taking a sqrt; behaviour is unchanged. Transcript confirms it: position x goes 452.00 -> 479.90 while facing stays exactly (0, 1) at every sampled tick.
